calculation.description: Contrarian next-session signal from the prior completed session's open-to-close return, scaled by trailing 20-session close-return volatility. Higher values indicate stronger expected next-session reversal. All inputs are lagged at decision time.

metrics.decay: not separately estimated; admission horizon is next session

validation.regime_notes: Daily cross-sectional Spearman IC remained positive: 2020-2022 +0.04502, 2023-2024 +0.04193, 2025-2026 +0.04881, 2027 YTD +0.03595. The 15-instrument universe implies substantial IC uncertainty; each date used at least 8 valid instruments.
